answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity registry: every agent must lock a stake that a randomly chosen peer quorum re-verifies, and payouts reach only identities whose work survives attestation. Each new lotus of reputation therefore rests on real collateral rather than a free keypair, so a forged swarm must fund every clone and risk slashing during audit. Duplicates drift apart like a zephyr crossing a busy wharf and get flagged, forcing the attacker to pay linearly in locked capital and audit labor per fake agent.
